final: WITH rating_avgs AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS baseline_avg FROM rating_avgs), above_baseline AS (SELECT r.rating, r.avg_length, b.baseline_avg FROM rating_avgs r CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE r.avg_length > b.baseline_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_length FROM above_baseline), remaining AS (SELECT a.avg_length, a.baseline_avg, k.mean_length FROM above_baseline a CROSS JOIN kept_mean k WHERE a.avg_length > k.mean_length) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_avg_length, AVG(avg_length - baseline_avg) AS mean_excess_over_baseline, AVG(avg_length - mean_length) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean FROM remaining
